{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows early negative momentum.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if price rises sharply, model should not overshoot by more than 5% above recent peak.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is consistently below true outcome over 5+ days, gradually increase forecast by 1-2% per day toward observed trend.",
    "When sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.5), allow forecast to lag slightly behind true outcome by 1-2 days to avoid overreaction.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), reduce forecast volatility — avoid sharp upward revisions unless sentiment confirms strong bullish momentum.",
    "If true outcome exceeds forecast by >10% for 3 consecutive days, reset forecast anchor to true outcome and apply 2% smoothing decay per day.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.0–0.5), prioritize historical mean reversion over sentiment-driven adjustments."
  ]
}
